## 6. The completed bosonic consequence

The independent bosonic attack also reached a complete result, which I have retained as a companion.

Consider independent senders with one fixed phase type per sender:
\[
c=
\sum_{\delta_j=0}W_ja_j+
\sum_{\delta_j=1}W_ja_j^\dagger+
Ue+Vf^\dagger,
\]
where \(e,f\) are fresh independent vacua and
\[
\sum_{\delta_j=0}W_jW_j^\dagger+UU^\dagger=(b+1)I_m,
\]
\[
\sum_{\delta_j=1}W_jW_j^\dagger+VV^\dagger=bI_m.
\]

Each sender has mean photon budget \(E_j\). It may use arbitrary non-Gaussian states and entangle all of its own ports and channel uses. No quantum entanglement or message-sharing link is supplied between senders.

Using accepted N557, the exact ordinary classical **sum capacity** is
\[
\boxed{
C_\Sigma=
\max_{\substack{Z_j\succeq0\\\operatorname{Tr}Z_j\le E_j}}
\operatorname{Tr}g\!\left(
bI_m+\sum_jW_jZ_jW_j^\dagger
\right)-m g(b),
}
\]
where
\[
g(x)=(x+1)\log_2(x+1)-x\log_2x.
\]

For one receiver mode,
\[
\boxed{
C_\Sigma=
g\!\left(b+\sum_j\|W_j\|_2^2E_j\right)-g(b).
}
\]

The main converse operation is to collect the annihilation and creation inputs into two independent groups and normalize each group passively. The received modes become
\[
c=\sqrt{b+1}\,u+\sqrt b\,v^\dagger.
\]
N557 then gives the block-length-uniform floor
\[
S(\text{received block}\mid\text{messages})\ge nm\,g(b),
\]
even with arbitrary entanglement across uses within each sender.

The average-output entropy is bounded using the **centered** normal covariance. This avoids the false raw-energy bound that coherent cross-sender means would invalidate. Independent Gaussian coherent modulation attains the resulting sum face through the finite cq MAC coding theorem. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="5"}

The result permits noncommuting sender covariance contributions. It does not claim the full individual-rate region or arbitrary unequal spontaneous-noise matrices.

### Executed numerical and receiver constructions

For a two-output example with
\[
W_1=
\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&1/2\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
W_2=
\begin{pmatrix}9/20&-1/5\\3/5&3/20\end{pmatrix},
\]
\(b=1\), and budgets \(2,3\), an exact global certificate gives
\[
\boxed{
2.2145317647
\le C_\Sigma\le
2.2145317648
\quad\text{bits/use}.
}
\]
The certification uses rational feasible covariances, a Gibbs dual, matrix-log enclosures and exact root isolation. The floating optimizer only proposes

## 7. Established boundary

The primary completed result is the **universal finite broadcast construction for noisy qubit profiles**, its **full ordinary-capacity spectrum**, and the **minimum output dimension for every capacity reduction**. The proof covers all Choi ranks and has a generic exact rational implementation.

The earlier thermodynamic, arithmetic, assisted-capacity, catalyst, detector and complete-profile constructions remain preserved unchanged. The independent rank-one-convexity attack produced a useful compatible reduction but no valid negative quasiconvexity witness; it is retained with that status.

The unrestricted quarter-bit approximation problem for ordinary quantum capacity is still not resolved by this work. Neither the spectrum theorem’s symbolic upper endpoint nor the paid heralded inverse supplies the missing ordinary-rate compiler. The new classification establishes exactly what a complete qubit statistical profile permits, including the physical output space required to realize it.
